newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia's Mah Sing buys Taiwan firm.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia's Mah Sing buys Taiwan firm.

text.p: Malaysian manufacturing and trading firm Mah Sing Group Bhd said its wholly owned unit has bought the entire issued and paid-up capital of Taiwan's Toptek International Inc for T$60 million in cash.
In a statement to the Kuala Lumpur Stock Exchange late on Thursday, Mah Sing said its Champion Computers Sdn Bhd unit had bought six million shares of Toptek, an investment holding firm.

Toptek has in turn bought stakes in two computer multimedia companies in Taiwan. It acquired a 51 percent equity stake in Toptek Multimedia Inc for T$38.7 million in cash, and 51 percent of Taiwan Multimedia Inc (TMI) for T$5.2 million.

Toptek Multimedia is owner, manufacturer and distributor of multimedia audio single-chip under the Toptek trademark. TMI owns, manufactures and distributes multimedia chip boards under the Gold Master name.
Mah Sing said the investments were part of its plans to expand its information technology activities into a core business activity.
